description: This file contains function declarations related to managing network device status parameters, including getters and setters for various parameter types (Ulong, String, Bool), as well as functions for commit, validate, rollback, and initialization procedures within a network device status module.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_Default_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG value for a given parameter name in the default network device status context.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_Default_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets a ULONG value for a given parameter name in the default network device status context.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG value for a specified parameter in the current network device status context.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets a ULONG value for a specified parameter in the current network device status context.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string value for a specified parameter.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a BOOL value for a specified parameter.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a BOOL value for a specified parameter.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_Commit
methods.description: Commits changes to the network device status.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_Validate
methods.description: Validates the current network device status parameters before applying changes.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back any changes made to network device status parameters.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_Default_Commit
methods.description: Commits default network device status parameters.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_Default_Validate
methods.description: Validates default network device status parameters.

methods.name: NetworkDevicesStatus_Default_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back default network device status parameters.

methods.name: CosaDmlNetworkDevicesStatusInit
methods.description: Initializes the network device status module.
